title: Shell and its imprint

doesNotKnow: The first panel represents a retained shell. The second shows the hollow surface that records its shape: an impression. Both are simplified; preservation can be more complicated.

misconception: The first apparent interpretation is the only possible one.
objective: A shell fossil and the hollow it left in surrounding rock are found. Which is the impression?
